content:
令

\[
L_n=\sqrt{n}\left(1-\sum_{k=1}^n\frac{1}{n+\sqrt{k}}\right)
\]

注意到

\[
1-\sum_{k=1}^n\frac{1}{n+\sqrt{k}}
=\sum_{k=1}^n\left(\frac1n-\frac{1}{n+\sqrt{k}}\right)
=\sum_{k=1}^n\frac{\sqrt{k}}{n(n+\sqrt{k})}
\]

因此

\[
L_n=\sum_{k=1}^n\frac{\sqrt{n}\sqrt{k}}{n(n+\sqrt{k})}
=\frac1n\sum_{k=1}^n\frac{\sqrt{k/n}}{1+\sqrt{k/n}/\sqrt{n}}
\]

当 \(n\to\infty\) 时，

\[
\frac{\sqrt{k/n}}{1+\sqrt{k/n}/\sqrt{n}}
\to \sqrt{k/n}
\]

所以

\[
\lim_{n\to\infty}L_n
=\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac1n\sum_{k=1}^n\sqrt{\frac{k}{n}}
=\int_0^1\sqrt{x}\,dx
=\frac{2}{3}
\]

答案：B
